<pre>
<nowiki>
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xs:schema
	xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
	
	<xs:element name="dictionary" type="dictionary" />
	
  <xs:complexType name="dictionary">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="direction" type="direction" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="direction">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="valsi" type="valsi" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
      <xs:element name="nlword" type="nlword" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
    </xs:sequence>
    <xs:attribute name="from" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
    <xs:attribute name="to" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
  </xs:complexType>
  
  <xs:complexType name="valsi">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="rafsi" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="3" />
      <xs:element name="selmaho" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0"/>
      <xs:element name="definition" type="xs:string"/>
      <xs:element name="notes" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" />
    </xs:sequence>
    <xs:attribute name="unofficial" type="xs:boolean" default="false" />
    <xs:attribute name="word" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
    <xs:attribute name="type" type="type-enum" use="required" />
  </xs:complexType>
  
  <xs:simpleType name="type-enum">
    <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
      <xs:enumeration value="cmavo" />
      <xs:enumeration value="cmavo cluster" />
      <xs:enumeration value="cmene" />
      <xs:enumeration value="experimental cmavo" />
      <xs:enumeration value="experimental gismu" />
      <xs:enumeration value="fu'ivla" />
      <xs:enumeration value="lujvo" />
      <xs:enumeration value="gismu" />
    </xs:restriction>
  </xs:simpleType>
  
  <xs:complexType name="nlword">
    <xs:attribute name="word" type="xs:string" use="required" />
    <xs:attribute name="sense" type="xs:string" use="optional"/>
    <xs:attribute name="valsi" type="xs:string" use="required" />
    <xs:attribute name="place" type="xs:positiveInteger" use="optional" />
  </xs:complexType>
    
</xs:schema>
</nowiki>
</pre>
